levels.full: Code database, Section C lookup, and jurisdiction packs with process notes, forms and standing packages.
levels.code_only: Code lookup for the adopted code, but no jurisdiction pack: no process notes, forms or standing packages.
levels.preview: Roadmap only. Batatis has neither the adopted code nor a pack; nothing it shows is specific to this region.

regions.name: Alberta
regions.note: NBC(AE) 2023, 2nd printing. Batatis prepares applications for the City of Calgary and the City of Edmonton, whose own variance steps it has checked. Every other Alberta place names its office from places/alberta.json and says Batatis does not prepare applications there yet.
